tour.slide1_greeting: Hi! I'm Sage, your on-chain AI agent. I'll guide you through BlockID.
tour.slide1_question: Is this your first time using Web3 or Blockchain?
tour.slide1b_a: A centralized database owned by one company
tour.slide1b_b: A decentralized digital ledger held by thousands
tour.slide1b_correct: Nice one! Feel free to explore BlockID, enjoy!
tour.slide1b_wrong: That seems off. Let me guide you through the tour first!
tour.slide2a_sage: Okay, let me explain what blockchain is.
tour.slide2a_body: Imagine a giant notebook held by thousands of people simultaneously around the world. Every transaction is recorded in this notebook. No one can change or delete it, because everyone holds the same copy. No bank. No middleman. Directly from you to anyone.
tour.slide2a_analogy: Think of a WhatsApp group with 1000 people. Every message sent is received and saved by everyone. No admin can delete it. That is blockchain.
tour.slide2b_sage: So what is the difference between Web2 and Web3?
tour.slide2b_summary: Simply put: Web2 = using what belongs to others. Web3 = you own it entirely.
tour.slide3_sage: There is one important thing you need to know about blockchain...
tour.slide3_body: Because there is no bank and no middleman, every transaction on blockchain is final. Cannot be cancelled. Cannot be refunded. Once sent, it cannot come back.
tour.slide3_warning: Before sending, you must be absolutely sure who the recipient is and whether they can be trusted.
tour.slide3_blockid: This is why BlockID exists. We help you identify who is behind every wallet before you transact.
tour.slide4_sage1: Welcome to BlockID Dashboard! Here you can share moments, follow wallets you trust, and explore the entire Solana ecosystem.
tour.slide4_sage2: One important thing. Every post you make here is linked directly to your wallet. No anonymous accounts. Everyone knows which wallet this post came from. Protect your reputation, because in BlockID, your identity is your wallet.
tour.slide5_sage1: This is your BlockID profile! In blockchain, your identity is not your name or photo. It is your reputation.
tour.slide5_trust: Trust Score: how trustworthy your wallet is on blockchain
tour.slide5_sage2: By the way... what do you want to be called here?
tour.slide5_skip: Skip, you can set it later in Edit Profile
tour.slide6_sage1: Look how easy it is to send crypto in BlockID! Follow my lead...
tour.slide6_sage2: BlockID understood your intent! Continue to verify the recipient...
tour.slide6_sage3: Before confirming, make sure the recipient is correct! Trust Score: how trustworthy this wallet is. Badge: on-chain activity track record. Wallet address: match it with your intended recipient. Everything is visible before you confirm. This is BlockID.
tour.slide7_sage: One more thing. You already have a free @handle.Block. But if you want an identity that is truly on-chain, permanent, and tradeable, you can buy your exclusive @handle here. The shorter the handle, the more premium its value. Like a domain on the internet, but for blockchain.
